summary: All rounding now lives in meterbill/money.py (round_amount, allocate, legacy_cents, fixed); the decimal-context line is gone, and CLI output matches the original on samples and fuzzed books. Context-dependent sites kept their old modes: half up on the main thread, half even on batch pool threads (new keyword-only `method` parameters on charge_bands, compute, effective_price, bill_record, batch_line). Quirks kept: VAT label and 'vat x.x%' round half up; a whole-unit payable never shows a negative zero while the 0.05-step payable can show -0.00.
